**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is gateway pool exhaustion. `in_use` pinned at 20 of 20 for the whole window, queue growing to 271. Impact ran `02:14:18` to `03:59:27` and was still live at log end. 530 `503`s in 636 requests, an 83% error rate.

Roll back `dep-4471`. Note that `/health` never `503`d, so uptime checks read green through all of it.
